task_title: Cache Azure sheet PNGs locally + bounded size cap

plan_review.notes: approve-with-changes on the size-cap eviction plan; all 8 concerns adopted. 2 blocking: (1) walk uses lstat and skips symlinks so eviction cannot escape the cache tree; (2) owner-only eviction — only files whose cache-relative key passes shouldCache are counted or deleted, so an overridden cacheDir sharing space with unrelated files is untouched. Plus: exempt the just-written entry, short-circuit entries larger than the whole cap, strict parseMaxCacheBytes validation (trim + digits-only + safe-integer), stale .tmp- sweep, and added symlink/tmp/oversized/factory-wiring tests.
